name: clickflash-installer
description: ClickFlash Unified 1-Click Installer — Master Portal + Touch Kiosk
author: ClickFlash Photography

scripts.build:electron: rimraf dist/electron && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npx javascript-obfuscator dist/electron/electron-main.js --output dist/electron/electron-main.js --compact true --control-flow-flattening true --dead-code-injection true --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 1
scripts.package: pnpm run prepare:license-trust && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && rimraf release/win-unpacked && electron-builder build --win --dir
scripts.package:installer: pnpm run prepare:license-trust && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && rimraf release/win-unpacked && electron-builder build --win
scripts.lint: eslint src installer-payload-installation.ts installer-payload-release.ts installer-payload-verification.ts installer-payload-trust.ts scripts/payload-release.ts --ext .ts,.tsx --max-warnings 50
